title: UPT Discovery Run Manifest
description: Versioned JSON artifact for a Product B probe search (`src/composition/probe`). Records the inputs, backends, budget, and environment needed to replay a run. `schemaVersion` is independent of `packageVersion`. Experimental — does not imply public API stability. TypeScript sources remain authoritative for in-memory types.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest major version. Parsers reject unknown incompatible majors. Additive optional fields do not require a bump.

repositoryCommit.description: Git commit of the UPT tree that produced the run.

problemHash.description: Canonical hash of the search problem (quantities, constraints, grammar bounds) excluding datasets.

datasetHashes.description: Canonical hashes of every dataset the run consumed, in declared input order.

backendDescriptors.description: Backends that generated or scored candidates in this run. External workers are untrusted; descriptors never include secrets.

protocolVersion.description: External-backend protocol version spoken by this worker.

backendId.description: Stable backend identity (native enumerator, user-supplied worker id, …).

backendVersion.description: Backend implementation version (or executable hash when a version string is unavailable).

capabilities.description: Declared backend capabilities for this run.

deterministic.description: Whether visit order and outputs are bitwise-deterministic, seed-reproducible, or neither.

randomSeeds.description: Named seeds consumed by stochastic backends. Empty object when the run is seed-independent.

tolerances.description: Named numeric tolerances that bound numerical (not bitwise) reproducibility.

environment.description: Runtime fingerprint. Does not promise bitwise reproducibility of GPU libraries or external solvers.

searchBudget.description: Hard search limits. Exhaustion yields a valid partial result plus `stopReason`.

maxAstDepth.description: Maximum expression-tree depth the enumerator may emit.

maxExternalProcesses.description: Optional cap on concurrent external backend processes.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run began.

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run stopped. Absent while in-flight.

stopReason.description: Why the search stopped. `no-credible-candidate` is a successful scientific outcome, not a failure. Budget exhaustion is a valid partial result.

nondeterminism.description: Declared sources of non-bitwise reproducibility (GPU libraries, external solvers, unordered hashing). Empty when the run claims bitwise determinism.
